affected_system: public participation, multilingual communication, consultation, and feedback closure
alternatives: rank verified high-consequence candidates for inclusive participation and communication improvement portfolio
select a risk-, equity-, and lifecycle-balanced portfolio for inclusive participation and communication improvement portfolio
pair representation, rights, usability, trust-risk, cost, and evidence prioritization with an explicit stop, review, and escalation rule
assumptions: Invitation, exposure, participation, contribution, response, decision, and trust remain distinct.
Participation records preserve consent, privacy, language, accessibility, and channel provenance.
All alternatives, capacities, costs, effects, thresholds, and failure scenarios are proposed until bound to evidence.
baseline: fund only already-committed work for inclusive participation and communication improvement portfolio.

constraints.description: The public participation and risk communication prioritize must respect declared capital, operating, maintenance, and delivery budgets.
Every released metric must retain evidence type, source lineage, geography, time, assumptions, and uncertainty.
No analytical output may bypass lawful authority, accountable human review, or an applicable appeal process.

decision_cadence: recompiled at each planning cycle and after material evidence change
decision_owner: public engagement director and risk communications lead
decision_question: Which language, accessibility, facilitation, compensation, channel, and feedback reforms should be funded?

independence_key.binding_constraint: The public participation and risk communication prioritize must respect declared capital, operating, maintenance, and delivery budgets.
independence_key.decision_object: inclusive participation and communication improvement portfolio
independence_key.evidence_gate: Evidence for inclusive participation and communication improvement portfolio passes documented checks for cost, benefit, service life, dependencies, deliverability, and maintenance burden.
independence_key.intervention_mechanism: representation, rights, usability, trust-risk, cost, and evidence prioritization
independence_key.primary_outcome: affected-population participation and feedback access gap

intended_claim: A versioned prioritize design for comparing declared alternatives affecting inclusive participation and communication improvement portfolio, conditional on its evidence gate.
limitations: This library record has no city binding and therefore reports no local input, output, or recommendation.
Readiness describes explicit source and method gates; it does not certify implementation feasibility.
External domain, legal, community, security, and operational review remains outside this design artifact.

objectives.metric: affected-population participation and feedback access gap
distributional gap in affected-population participation and feedback access gap
decision claims with complete evidence lineage

prohibited_claims: Do not report modeled inclusion as representative participation, consent, trust, or influence.
Do not describe a design-only record as a city execution, deployment, adopted policy, or impact result.
Do not relabel proposed, estimated, simulated, optimized, or causal evidence as observed evidence.
Do not infer individual behavior, protected status, harm, or entitlement from aggregate records.

release_gate.failure_release: Release an explicit insufficient-evidence record naming missing sources, failed diagnostics, prohibited claims, and the next validation action.
release_gate.pass_condition: Evidence for inclusive participation and communication improvement portfolio passes documented checks for cost, benefit, service life, dependencies, deliverability, and maintenance burden.

title: Prioritize inclusive participation and communication improvements
transportability_risks: Trust, language, civic institutions, digital access, deliberation norms, and risk salience differ.
Participants are not automatically representative of affected populations.
